ImageDescription.value: The GSMA's Mobile for Development Foundation created the Mobile Internet Skills Training Toolkit (MISTT) to promote digital inclusion via mobile. This PDF contains a set of train-the-trainer style resources that introduce the basics of mobile internet, common applications, mobile money, accessibility features and staying safe online. If you are interested in rolling out a training that uses MISTT with advisory support from the GSMA Connected Society programme, or would like to hear about best practices, you can get in touch with us by emailing connectedsociety@GSMA.com. Even if you don't need support, it would be great to hear how you are using the materials so we can enable the sharing of best practices. You can find additional information resources related to MISTT at our website: https://www.gsma.com/mobilefordevelopment/connected-society/mistt/
